map_info.name: WaveFunctions_TrigWalkingPath
map_info.title: A Slow Pulse from Fast Motions
map_info.description: Compare two adjustable visual oscillations with their half-scaled sum. Nearby frequencies produce a slow envelope; equal frequencies remove that beating. The finite TrigWalkingPath remains a secondary spatial comparison alongside sine oscillation, Lissajous curves and wave interference.

learning_objectives: Compare two frequencies with their visual sum
Relate the slow envelope to absolute frequency difference
Distinguish half-scaled display height from the raw sum
Keep visual beats distinct from audible demonstrations

documentation.summary: Beats: changing relation between two signals; finite walking paths remain secondary.
documentation.layout: 34x48m. Beat controls face arrival; learner bay hall-local (23,0,12), yaw180. Full 24m circulating paths occupy an open catch basin, with a near bridge, far ramp and side descent. Separate later visual studies.
documentation.limits: Floor-level access and basin ramps tested; full moving-path traversal and headset comfort require playtesting.
